sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves vacuous applicability, authoritative owners and paths, all declared operands and results, selected-to-source hull area factor correspondence, span/frameSpan reconciliation, expected-result-scaled tolerance, correct formula and unit conversion, and the direct actual shear-area comparison against the formula-derived requirement.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The COMPLETE dependency contract requires the omitted hullAreaFactor operand. It must remain on its authoritative hullAreaValue owner, not be relocated to the ship or structural member; locate and use the canonical ship-to-hullAreaValue path, then constrain hullAreaFactor as a decimal unitless quantity while retaining selectedHullAreaFactor. Also prevent an accidental tolerance pass: separately validate reported requiredTransverseFrameShearArea against the formula result using tolerance scaled from the expected result, but compare actual shearArea (converted from m2 to cm2) directly against the expected formula-derived A_t, not against the potentially lower tolerated reported value. Preserve vacuous applicability when no structural member exists; do not add relationship minCount solely from the universal rule.

The prior hullAreaFactor repair is only presence-level: ?hullAreaFactor is bound but never used, so the COMPLETE contract’s declared operand and its relationship to the member’s selectedHullAreaFactor remain unenforced. For each structural member, require its selectedHullAreaFactor to correspond to an applicable hullAreaFactor on a ship-linked hullAreaValue, then use that validated AF in the A_t calculation; avoid an arbitrary member-by-all-area Cartesian join. Also integrate the required ship-owned span operand into the frame-span-a/LL calculation rather than merely requiring it while computing LL solely from frameSpan; reconcile span and frameSpan as representations of the same formula input without dropping either declared operand. Preserve the expected-result-scaled tolerance for reported requiredTransverseFrameShearArea, the direct actualArea*10000 >= expectedArea comparison, authoritative owners, and vacuous applicability when no structural member exists.

Candidate faithfully preserves vacuous applicability, authoritative owners and paths, all declared operands and results, selected-to-source hull area factor correspondence, span/frameSpan reconciliation, expected-result-scaled tolerance, correct formula and unit conversion, and the direct actual shear-area comparison against the formula-derived requirement.
